import adsk.core, adsk.fusion, json
def p(x,y): return adsk.core.Point3D.create(x,y,0)
def rectangle(sk,x0,y0,x1,y1):
    ls=sk.sketchCurves.sketchLines
    ls.addByTwoPoints(p(x0,y0),p(x1,y0)); ls.addByTwoPoints(p(x1,y0),p(x1,y1)); ls.addByTwoPoints(p(x1,y1),p(x0,y1)); ls.addByTwoPoints(p(x0,y1),p(x0,y0))
def circle(sk,cx,cy,r):
    sk.sketchCurves.sketchCircles.addByCenterRadius(p(cx,cy),r)
def ext(root,sk,dist,op,name):
    f=root.features.extrudeFeatures.addSimple(sk.profiles.item(0),adsk.core.ValueInput.createByReal(dist),op); f.name=name; return f
def run(_context):
    app=adsk.core.Application.get()
    doc=app.documents.add(adsk.core.DocumentTypes.FusionDesignDocumentType,True)
    des=adsk.fusion.Design.cast(doc.products.itemByProductType('DesignProductType'))
    root=des.rootComponent
    im=app.importManager
    refpath='/Users/daiki/Projects/sage60/pcb/mx_plate_right_tb/gasket_v1/mx_plate_right_tb_gasket.dxf'
    refopts=im.createDXF2DImportOptions(refpath,root.xYConstructionPlane); im.importToTarget(refopts,root)
    ref=root.sketches.item(0); bb=ref.boundingBox
    x0=bb.minPoint.x-0.40; x1=bb.maxPoint.x+0.40; y0=bb.minPoint.y-0.40; y1=bb.maxPoint.y+0.40
    ix0=bb.minPoint.x-0.10; ix1=bb.maxPoint.x+0.10; iy0=bb.minPoint.y-0.10; iy1=bb.maxPoint.y+0.10
    s=root.sketches.add(root.xYConstructionPlane); s.name='RIGHT_CASE_OUTER_PROFILE'; rectangle(s,x0,y0,x1,y1); ext(root,s,0.80,adsk.fusion.FeatureOperations.NewBodyFeatureOperation,'RIGHT_CASE_WALL_BLANK')
    s2=root.sketches.add(root.xYConstructionPlane); s2.name='RIGHT_CASE_CAVITY_PROFILE'; rectangle(s2,ix0,iy0,ix1,iy1); ext(root,s2,0.80,adsk.fusion.FeatureOperations.CutFeatureOperation,'RIGHT_CASE_CAVITY')
    s3=root.sketches.add(root.xYConstructionPlane); s3.name='RIGHT_CASE_FLOOR_PROFILE'; rectangle(s3,x0,y0,x1,y1); ext(root,s3,0.25,adsk.fusion.FeatureOperations.JoinFeatureOperation,'RIGHT_CASE_FLOOR')
    cx=16.0995; cy=-11.4535; hole=1.85; lip=2.10
    sh=root.sketches.add(root.xYConstructionPlane); sh.name='TRACKBALL_D35_CLEARANCE'; circle(sh,cx,cy,hole); ext(root,sh,0.80,adsk.fusion.FeatureOperations.CutFeatureOperation,'TRACKBALL_CLEARANCE')
    so=root.sketches.add(root.xYConstructionPlane); so.name='TRACKBALL_SUPPORT_LIP_OUTER'; circle(so,cx,cy,lip); ext(root,so,0.20,adsk.fusion.FeatureOperations.JoinFeatureOperation,'TRACKBALL_SUPPORT_LIP')
    si=root.sketches.add(root.xYConstructionPlane); si.name='TRACKBALL_SUPPORT_LIP_INNER'; circle(si,cx,cy,hole); ext(root,si,0.20,adsk.fusion.FeatureOperations.CutFeatureOperation,'TRACKBALL_SUPPORT_OPENING')
    pads=[('R1',17.10,-2.6075,1.40,0.30),('R2',10.387,-1.94075,1.40,0.30),('R3',19.2095,-7.40,0.30,1.40),('R4',5.2258,-8.00,0.30,1.40),('R5',19.2095,-9.60,0.30,1.40),('R6',7.94065,-12.9381,1.40,0.30)]
    for name,pcx,pcy,w,h in pads:
        sp=root.sketches.add(root.xYConstructionPlane); sp.name='RIGHT_GASKET_'+name; rectangle(sp,pcx-w/2,pcy-h/2,pcx+w/2,pcy+h/2); ext(root,sp,0.80,adsk.fusion.FeatureOperations.JoinFeatureOperation,'RIGHT_GASKET_PAD_'+name); sp.isVisible=False
    for sk in root.sketches: sk.isVisible=False
    if root.bRepBodies.count: root.bRepBodies.item(0).name='RIGHT_TRACKBALL_CASE_BOTTOM'
    mgr=des.exportManager
    stl=mgr.createSTLExportOptions(root.bRepBodies.item(0),'/Users/daiki/Projects/sage60/mechanical/gasket_v1/sage60_right_tb_case_bottom.stl'); ok1=mgr.execute(stl)
    step=mgr.createSTEPExportOptions('/Users/daiki/Projects/sage60/mechanical/gasket_v1/sage60_right_tb_case_bottom.step',root); ok2=mgr.execute(step)
    print(json.dumps({'case':'right_trackball','document':doc.name,'bounds_cm':[x0,y0,x1,y1],'trackball_center_cm':[cx,cy],'trackball_hole_diameter_mm':37.0,'gasketPads':len(pads),'stl':bool(ok1),'step':bool(ok2),'bodies':[b.name for b in root.bRepBodies]}))
